theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_measure_eq_hausdorff
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)), 1 ≤ m → IsOpen D → μ Dᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → μ K ≠ ∞) → Measurable ν → (∀ y, ‖ν y‖ = 1) → (∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ∀ f : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ m)⁻¹ * ∫ z, f (r⁻¹ • (z - y)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ z in ((Submodule.span ℝ {ν y})ᗮ : Set (Euclid (m + 1))), f z ∂μHE[m]))) → (∀ S : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), MeasurableSet S → CountablyRectifiable m S → μHE[m] S ≠ ∞ → ∀ᵐ w ∂(μHE[m].restrict S), Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => μHE[m] (S ∩ ball w t) / (unitBallVolume m * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ m))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)) → ∃ B : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), MeasurableSet B ∧ B ⊆ D ∧ CountablyRectifiable m B ∧ μ = μHE[m].restrict B ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[m].restrict B), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m B y (Submodule.span ℝ {ν y})ᗮ
